summary: The audit checks 45 units of Math and Science (at least 24 in Math and 20 in Science), Technology in Society, the Engineering Fundamentals, 12 units of Technical Electives, and ME 170A and 170B for WIM and the capstone. Every course must be letter graded when a letter grade is offered, with a C or better, and each course counts in only one category. Checked by hand: extra Math and Science courses from the School of Engineering lists, the 2.7 GPA, the 68 units of Engineering Topics, and taking courses in prerequisite order. Left: the Bulletin does not list the Mechanical Engineering Depth courses, so you move them in yourself from the ME program sheet. Honors is optional.

vqUzCgBL.why: Notes, with the page's course links filled in: "Only 3 units in total from [DESIGN 223] and/or [DESIGN 298] can be counted towards the Technical Electives requirement." "Only 3 units in total from [ME 170C] and/or [ME 191] can be counted towards the Technical Electives requirement." ME 191 counts only after an approved petition, so it is moved in by hand and still falls under the cap.

RcuRciyi.why: "Technology in Society (TiS): Complete ANY of the following Courses: AA 252, BIOE 131, COMM 120W, CS 181, ENERGY 177A AND ENERGY 177B, EPS 194 OR EPS 204, HUMBIO 174, NBIO 101 OR NBIO 201". ENERGY 177A and 177B are one option together; the data split them, so either alone passed.

d2cXs5AO.why: Science moves under the combined Math and Science rule (see esaUB1gf).

esaUB1gf.why: "The program requires a minimum of 45 units of math and science combined, including 24 units in math and 20 units in science. The 45th unit may be either math or science." The additional Math and Science rules ("Additional courses from the School of Engineering's approved Math course list ... to reach the 24-unit minimum" and the same for Science) name a list that is not in this program's data, so they take approved courses the student moves in and count only toward the floors. "ACE units do not count toward major program unit minimums" is checked by hand.

children.name: Mathematics
children.desc:
The program requires a minimum of 45 units of math and science combined, including 24 units in math and 20 units in science. The 45th unit may be either math or science. ACE units do not count toward major program unit minimums, though they do count toward the 180-unit minimum needed for graduation.
The CME courses in mathematics are strongly preferred for ME majors.

children.name: Calculus
children.notes:
10 units of AP Calculus BC, with placement into course/course, is equivalent to course/course/course and acceptable in any engineering major. If 6-8 units of AP or IB credit are given, course must be taken regardless of the Math Diagnostic Placement results.
Recommended Timeline: Taken in the 1st year.

children.name: Vector Calculus
children.notes: Recommended Timeline: Taken in Autumn of the 2nd year or earlier.

children.name: Ordinary Differential Equations
children.notes: Recommended Timeline: Taken in Autumn of the 2nd year or earlier.

children.name: Additional Math Courses
children.desc: Additional courses from the School of Engineering's approved Math course list for 2026-27 to reach the 24-unit minimum of Math coursework, and/or the 45-unit minimum for Math and Science. The list is available in the Mathematics and Statistics subsection within the Engineering-BS School Requirements.
children.notes: If course and course are both taken, only 8 units of credit will be allowed toward the SoE major program due to overlapping material.

children.name: Science
children.desc: The program requires a minimum of 45 units of math and science combined, including 20 units in science and 24 units in math. The 45th unit may be either math or science. ACE units do not count toward major program unit minimums, though they do count toward the 180-unit minimum needed for graduation.

children.name: Mechanics
children.notes:
A score of 5 on the AP Physics C Mechanics exam may be used to satisfy this requirement. AP credits can only be applied if the parallel Stanford courses are skipped.
Recommended Timeline: Taken by Autumn of the 2nd year.

children.name: Electricity and Magnetism
children.notes:
A score of 5 on the AP Physics C Electricity & Magnetism exam may be used to satisfy this requirement. AP credits can only be applied if the parallel Stanford courses are skipped.
Recommended Timeline: Taken by Winter of the 2nd year.

children.name: Additional Science Courses
children.desc: Additional courses from the School of Engineering's approved Science course list for 2026-27 to reach the 20-unit minimum of Science coursework, and/or the 45-unit minimum for Math and Science. The list is available in the Mathematics and Statistics subsection within the Engineering-BS School Requirements.
children.notes: AP Physics 1&2 and Physics 20 courses are not allowed as science units.
